BiblicalUsage: Sha'ah is being stunned, astonished, wondering — and Abraham's servant stood wondering at Rebekah, holding his peace, to wit whether the LORD had made his journey prosperous or not.
TheologicalSignificance: What I take from this is that wondering is the servant's wisdom: he held his peace until he knew whether God had prospered the way.
